entry.confirm_signal: Four-tone melody about 5 s after power-up; the motor does not start.
steps: Throttle signal at full power (transmitter on).
Connect the drive battery; switch the BEC on where fitted (MasterSpin 11 has no switch).
Wait about 5 s for the four-tone melody.
Wait about 5 s more; the groups start.

announce.description: Groups of 1 to 6 beeps, each group repeated five times in a row, then the next count. Group N is mode N. A group ends after its fifth repetition. Competition types have fewer modes: the manual says six modes 'except the special competition types' without naming the count. Whether the series loops is not stated.

select.description: Move the throttle to the stop position while the wanted group is sounding.

skip.description: Keep full throttle; the next group follows.

scheme.confirm_signal: Tone sequence for the brake setting of the new mode (one beep brake, two beeps no brake); the ESC is then armed.
scheme.exit: Disconnect the battery. The motor runs on throttle movement right after the confirmation.
scheme.description: Throttle at full, then power: four-tone melody after about 5 s, groups of 1 to 6 beeps after about 5 s more, each five times. Throttle to stop during the wanted group selects that mode and stores it. Factory state is mode 1.

items.name: Mode

values.name: Acro inrunner: no brake, timing 0 degrees, LiPo autodetect, slow down at 3.0 V per cell
Acro outrunner: no brake, timing 24 degrees, LiPo autodetect, slow down at 3.0 V per cell
Glider inrunner: brake on, timing 0 degrees, LiPo autodetect, slow down at 3.0 V per cell
Glider outrunner: brake on, timing 24 degrees, LiPo autodetect, slow down at 3.0 V per cell
Heli constant rpm, normal speed correction (no fast speed changes), timing 0 degrees
Heli constant rpm 3D, fast speed correction, timing 0 degrees

items.note: Mode 1 suits Hacker B and C inrunners and other 2-pole inrunners; modes 2 and 4 suit A-series and 10 to 14 pole outrunners. LiPo autodetect needs a fully charged pack.

unknowns: Beep length, gap between beeps, gap between groups (ms): not stated.
Wait before the melody and between melody and groups: 'about 5 s', no tolerance.
Whether the group series loops after group 6: not stated.
Number of modes on the competition types (F5B, F5D, F5F): not stated.
Beep pattern of the confirmation: only note symbols.
notes: Model table: Hacker_MasterSpin.pdf p16 and Hacker_MasterSpin_de.pdf p16 list MasterSpin 170 Opto and 220 Opto; Hacker_MasterSpin_old_en.pdf p16 (Release 0107) lists 200 Opto and 300 Opto in their place with the same size and voltage data.
Hacker_MasterSpin_de.pdf lists the tables with several rows broken across lines; values were read from the English editions where the text layout is ambiguous.
The table row 'MasterSpin 66' states a current of 70 A.
After a normal power-up the ESC beeps once (brake on) or twice (brake off), then after about 5 s plays timing monitor beeps (can be disabled with the JetiBox) (p8).
All three editions list six groups, 1 to 6 beeps.
